name: Fintech Product Launch VSL
description: A 60-second cinematic launch video for a trading, fintech, or SaaS product. Dark theme, one accent color, animated chart and UI reveals, pricing beat, and end card. Highly customizable: every scene is built from editable layers, so you can swap the logo, screenshots, copy, accent color, timing, and section order without rebuilding anything. Built for a TradingView indicator, works for any dashboard or data product.
